description: JSON Schema from a sample — Turn a sample JSON document into a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) offline: types (integer vs number), nested objects, merged array item shapes, required keys (only those present in every sample object), and string formats (date, date-time, email, uri, uuid, ipv4). Use it to validate API payloads, write tool definitions or document a response. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

json.description: a sample JSON document (URL-encoded), e.g. an object with id 7, email a@b.co and tags [x]
